name: Residence Permit SD-JWT VC Type Metadata

display.label: JWT ID
display.description: A unique identifier for the token

display.label: Issued At
display.description: The time at which the JWT was issued

display.label: Expiration Time
display.description: The time on, or after which the JWT MUST NOT be accepted

display.label: Verifiable Credential Type
display.description: A URI identifying the credential type

display.label: Issuer
display.description: The Principal that issued the JWT

display.label: Confirmation
display.description: Key to be used by the Holder to verify Proof of Possession

display.label: Json Web Key
display.description: Json Web Key to be used by the Holder to verify Proof of Possession

display.label: Family Name(s)
display.description: The family name(s) of the permit holder

display.label: Given Name(s)
display.description: The given name(s) of the permit holder

display.label: Date of Birth
display.description: The date of birth of the permit holder

display.label: Nationality
display.description: Alpha-2 country code, as specified in ISO 3166-1, representing the nationality of the permit holder

display.label: Document Number
display.description: The number of the residence permit document

display.label: Administrative Number
display.description: A reference number for the procedure/case that resulted in this residence permit

display.label: Issuing Authority
display.description: The name of the authority that issued the residence permit

display.label: Issuing Country
display.description: Alpha-2 country code, as specified in ISO 3166-1, of the country of the issuer

display.label: Date of Issuance
display.description: The date on which the residence permit was issued

display.label: Date of Expiry
display.description: The date on which the residence permit expires

display.label: Resident Address
display.description: The registered residential address of the permit holder
